3.2 Threat model
We assume an attacker who can place text in documents that a retrieval sys-
tem later indexes. The attacker cannot modify the model or its conﬁguration,
and has no access to the user’s ﬁles. Prior work [4, 7] showed that injected
instructions such as “ignore the previous instructions” can redirect an
assistant; we therefore evaluate defenses that ﬁlter retrieved passages.

Table 2: Detection results (precision / recall)
Method        P      R
Keyword       0.91   0.42
Classifier    0.88   0.71
